Strategy: Broad size-conditioned fit. When the item is at most half of the largest feasible residual, place it in the roomiest bin to preserve tight bins for large items; otherwise rank like Best Fit. The choice differs from Best Fit for small-to-medium items when a roomier bin exists. It may help by saving tight slots more often than a stricter threshold, but may fail if the roomiest bin was the only one able to hold a later large item.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [r if item * 2 <= max(bins) else -(r - item) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Broad size-conditioned fit: item <= max residual/2 -> roomiest bin, else Best Fit.
